description: TwexAPI documentation for REST API, MCP, SDKs, CLI, Terraform, n8n, Prefect, Haystack, Paperclip, and X/Twitter public reads with an API key. Not affiliated with X Corp.
rules: Public reads use Authorization Bearer and X_API_SCRAPER_KEY.
Public docs focus on API-key reads. Never collect X passwords.
MCP tools are explore and twexapi_request at https://api.twexapi.io/mcp.
Timeline pages are POST /twitter/{screen_name}/timeline/page. Tweet detail is POST /v2/tweet/detail.
Do not document webhooks, monitors, or OAuth CIMD. They are not in this OpenAPI.
